scripts.db:verify:local: pnpm db:migrate:local && wrangler d1 execute DB --local --command "PRAGMA foreign_key_check; PRAGMA integrity_check; SELECT COUNT(*) FROM institutions; SELECT COUNT(*) FROM idempotency_records; SELECT COUNT(*) FROM outbox_events; SELECT COUNT(*) FROM audit_events; SELECT COUNT(*) FROM background_tasks;"
scripts.db:migrate:staging: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --env staging
scripts.db:migrate:production: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --env production
